title: lithocarpus dealbatus subsp. eudealbatus
intro: Lithocarpus dealbatus subsp. eudealbatus, commonly known as the Ede Sap or Mountain Hickory, is a plant species native to East Asia. The health benefits of Lithocarpus dealbatus subsp. eudealbatus include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to prevent cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to lower blood sugar levels, reduce blood pressure, and act as an antimicrobial agent, making it a potential treatment for various diseases. The bioactive constituents of Lithocarpus dealbatus subsp. eudealbatus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
